question: Do the four simultaneously soluble native covers on each of the observed +7 and +8 fibres give three or four independent quotient directions?
selection: Only 08234-003 and 08234-009, their retained independent witness bases, and the four points already constructed from exact cover square values. This is an explicitly oracle-assisted retrospective diagnostic, never a prospective selector.
method: Use a 100-decimal-digit canonical-height Gram matrix only to propose rational coordinates in the existing witness basis, with denominator at most64. Verify each resulting cleared-denominator relation by exact elliptic-curve group addition. Only verified coordinates determine quotient ranks and relation kernels modulo the marked17 generic points. An independent verifier replays the exact relations without numerical heights.
failure_semantics: A numerical projection is not a relation. Failed reconstruction, nonzero exact residual, or timeout preserves the earlier quotient interval3..4. No full original-fibre rank claim is introduced.
